name: Crew-13
slot_a_text: SLC-40 has flown 401 launches since it opened, 48 of them this year. The pad had 17 days to reset after the last one.
slot_b_text: SpaceX's 114th launch of the year, 733rd all time. Their year has run at a launch every other day. Falcon 9 is on a 336-flight success streak. Worldwide, it is attempt number 234 of the year.
description: SpaceX Crew-13 is the thirteenth crewed operational flight of a Crew Dragon spacecraft to the International Space Station as part of NASA's Commercial Crew Program.
program_description: The Commercial Crew Program (CCP) is a human spaceflight program operated by NASA, in association with American aerospace manufacturers Boeing and SpaceX. The program conducts rotations between the expeditions of the International Space Station program, transporting crews to and from the International Space Station (ISS) aboard Boeing Starliner and SpaceX Crew Dragon capsules, in the first…
rocket_fact: Pogo oscillation is a coupled vibration between a rocket's propulsion system and its structure that can become dangerously unstable.
